calls.head: The Blue Jackets’ defense joins the attack, the Flyers’ stays home
calls.body: On shots from defensemen, Columbus is one of the league’s best, but Philadelphia is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Watch the Blue Jackets’ defensemen jump into the play.

calls.head: Forecheck vs. Patience
calls.body: The Blue Jackets hound the puck, but the Flyers sit back. Columbus is one of the league’s best for forecheck pressure, and Philadelphia is near the bottom. Expect the Blue Jackets to win more pucks back deep in the Flyers’ end.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Zegras sparks a Flyers comeback
paras: Dmitri Voronkov and Matthew Knies scored a minute apart early in the first to put the Blue Jackets up 2-0. Trevor Zegras got the Flyers on the board late in the period, and Matvei Michkov tied it up early in the second. Dante Fabbro and Owen Tippett squared off early in the period. Denver Barkey put the Flyers ahead 3-2 on the power play early in the period. Adam Fantilli tied it 3-3 for Columbus less than four minutes later, but the Blue Jackets didn’t score again. Barkey scored his second of the night midway through the third to put the Flyers ahead for good.

The Flyers were outshot 31-21, but their looks were better, and the chances came out about even. Joseph Woll made 28 saves for the Flyers, and Jet Greaves stopped 17 of 21 at the other end. The Flyers moved to 6-10-6 and climbed to sixth in the Metropolitan, while the Blue Jackets fell to 7-11-0, still last in the Metropolitan.

items.text: The Blue Jackets are on a four-game losing streak.
Adam Fantilli extended his point streak against Philadelphia to seven games.
Dmitri Voronkov scored his first goal of the season, his first since Jan 24 (24 games played since).
Jet Greaves is winless in his last six starts (0-6-0).
